name: threads
title: Threads
description: Flowing threads that fray apart and part around the cursor, from fine silk to contour lines.

files.content:
import type { ThreadsLook, ThreadsPreset } from './types';

const CLASSIC: ThreadsLook = {
  lineCount: 40,
  thickness: 1,
  softness: 1,
  amplitude: 1,
  distance: 0,
  waves: 1,
  speed: 1,
  split: 0.1,
  fray: 0.4,
  angle: 0,
  taper: 1,
  brightness: 1,
  parting: 0,
  enableMouseInteraction: true,
  fade: 0,
  opacity: 1,
  seed: 0,
};

const PRESETS: Record<ThreadsPreset, ThreadsLook> = {
  classic: CLASSIC,
  silk: {
    ...CLASSIC,
    lineCount: 90,
    thickness: 0.6,
    softness: 1.3,
    amplitude: 1.7,
    distance: 0.4,
    waves: 1.05,
    speed: 0.6,
    split: 0.04,
    fray: 0.5,
    angle: 25,
    taper: 0.85,
    brightness: 1.4,
  },
  rope: {
    ...CLASSIC,
    lineCount: 24,
    thickness: 1.6,
    amplitude: 1.2,
    distance: 0.12,
    split: 0.3,
    fray: 0.15,
    waves: 1.3,
    taper: 0.4,
    brightness: 1.5,
  },
  strands: {
    ...CLASSIC,
    lineCount: 14,
    thickness: 2.6,
    softness: 0.6,
    amplitude: 2.2,
    distance: 0.7,
    speed: 0.5,
    waves: 0.6,
    fray: 0.6,
    taper: 0.55,
    brightness: 1.3,
  },
  contour: {
    ...CLASSIC,
    lineCount: 46,
    thickness: 0.9,
    softness: 0,
    amplitude: 0.9,
    distance: 1.7,
    split: 0,
    fray: 0.15,
    waves: 0.7,
    speed: 0.6,
    taper: 0,
    brightness: 1.25,
    opacity: 0.7,
    parting: 0.8,
    enableMouseInteraction: false,
  },
  curtain: {
    ...CLASSIC,
    angle: 90,
    lineCount: 34,
    thickness: 1.2,
    softness: 0,
    amplitude: 0.45,
    distance: 1.75,
    split: 0,
    fray: 0.1,
    waves: 0.55,
    speed: 0.7,
    taper: 0,
    brightness: 1.3,
    opacity: 0.8,
    parting: 0.8,
    enableMouseInteraction: false,
  },
};

/** The look of one of the demo presets. */
export function threadsPreset(name: ThreadsPreset): ThreadsLook {
  return { ...PRESETS[name] };
}

export function isThreadsPreset(value: unknown): value is ThreadsPreset {
  return typeof value === 'string' && value in PRESETS;
}
